lines.text: Read pci_device_read_irq, InterruptAttachThread and InterruptWait in the probe. Clear stale status (ack 0x64), attach with TRK_MSK, arm a two-second TimerTimeout, raise bit 1 at 0x60, verify own pending bit at 0x24 and acknowledge before detach. Default attach initially unmasks: an extra unmask at count zero returns EAGAIN. Then inspect edu_dma_roundtrip: contiguous uncached MAP_PHYS memory, mem_offset physical range inside 32-bit dma_mask, checked bus mastering, two bounded 64-byte transfers and byte comparison. QEMU device buffer starts at 0x40000; never substitute a virtual pointer for the physical bus address. DMA completion is POLLED, not an IRQ claim. On failed quiescence the reference retains the allocation until the bounded external VM owner stops it.

A write is one complete command: 1–2 ASCII digits, optional LF, maximum three bytes, 0..12. Nonblocking requests return EAGAIN; results have per-open snapshots, offsets and EOF. Register /dev/edu mode 0660 only after PCI/BAR/IAT setup; dispatch remains a long-running process.

lines.text: Before releasing the physical allocation, disable PCI bus mastering and check the returned command. This blocks future DMA transactions in the tested QEMU PCI address-space model. After releasing the mapping, restore the original command. This is NOT proof of device-specific quiescence on physical hardware.
lines.label: UNVERIFIED unless bounded by REVIEW.md catalog
lines.note: Instruction/planned/expected/source-design text is not runtime proof; candidate references do not assert full sentence acceptance.

lines.text: If bus mastering cannot be disabled/read back, the diagnostic deliberately retains the mapping and waits for the external VM supervisor rather than freeing a potentially live DMA buffer. The private native harness bounds its wait loop to180seconds, with additional bounded handshake/termination cleanup, and terminates the owned VM; it also caps CPU100%, host memory1GiB, nice15. Never run this diagnostic without an equivalent bounded VM supervisor. A quiescence failure is not success and is not a production-driver shutdown design.

lines.note: Instruction/planned/expected/source-design text is not runtime proof; candidate references do not assert full sentence acceptance.

lines.text: Read the assigned IRQ through the owned device handle; attach a notification using APIs/abilities from the installed QNX 8 headers, unmask deliberately, arm a bounded wait, request an edu interrupt, confirm pending status, acknowledge the device, and verify it cleared. Separate device acknowledgement from kernel unmasking. Exercise timeout and detach cleanup. The native one-shot event-wait probe now raises status1, wakes with status1 and acknowledges it clear. Historical event-attachment diagnostics preceded the current reference IAT path. Current InterruptAttachThread attachment handles the initial unmask; the removed redundant InterruptUnmask returned EAGAIN at mask countzero. Do not blindly unmask twice. This is not a complete production interrupt service thread.

lines.text: The original native/edu_dma.h now performs a byte-exact 64-byte RAM->EDU->RAM round-trip with polled completion on the fixed x86 QEMU configuration. See [native DMA contract](native-dma.md): one uncached contiguous page, checked physical offset/range, explicit 32-bit device mask, bus-master enable/readback, bounded waits and QEMU-specific quiescence before release. DMA IRQ and fault-injection acceptance remain pending. Do not use this diagnostic on physical hardware. Allocate a bounded buffer, establish physical contiguity and address range, initialize known bytes, transfer both directions with finite completion waits, and compare every byte. Never pass a virtual pointer as a DMA address. Quiesce DMA/interrupts before unmapping or freeing; verify timeout/error paths cannot reuse an in-flight buffer.

Unmap and detach on every acquired-resource failure.

lines.label: UNVERIFIED unless bounded by REVIEW.md catalog

lines.text: ## Goal and source boundary
lines.label: UNVERIFIED unless bounded by REVIEW.md catalog
lines.note: Instruction/planned/expected/source-design text is not runtime proof; candidate references do not assert full sentence acceptance.

lines.text: Read pci_device_read_irq, InterruptAttachThread and InterruptWait in the probe. Clear stale status (ack 0x64), attach with TRK_MSK, arm a two-second TimerTimeout, raise bit 1 at 0x60, verify own pending bit at 0x24 and acknowledge before detach. Default attach initially unmasks: an extra unmask at count zero returns EAGAIN. Then inspect edu_dma_roundtrip: contiguous uncached MAP_PHYS memory, mem_offset physical range inside 32-bit dma_mask, checked bus mastering, two bounded 64-byte transfers and byte comparison. QEMU device buffer starts at 0x40000; never substitute a virtual pointer for the physical bus address. DMA completion is POLLED, not an IRQ claim. On failed quiescence the reference retains the allocation until the bounded external VM owner stops it.

lines.note: Instruction/planned/expected/source-design text is not runtime proof; candidate references do not assert full sentence acceptance.
